steps.title: Install the photo assistant on your computer
steps.text: Choose Windows or Mac, copy the installation command and run it. A setup page with a QR code opens automatically when installation finishes.

steps.text: Install LomoMobile and join the same home network. Scan the computer’s setup code inside the app, then create an account and choose storage. The app recommends the drive with the most free space.

steps.title: Keep today’s photos. Help family join.
steps.text: Allow access to the photos you want to back up and check progress. You can also create separate accounts for family members and let them scan a code to sign in.

en.memoryText: That summer away. A familiar smile. Browse your collection and find your way back to moments that still mean everything — without keeping every original on your phone.
en.faqTitle: A little clarity, before you start.

faqs.question: Do I install it on my phone or my computer?
faqs.answer: For the first setup, prepare photo storage on a computer or NAS and install the phone app. If your household already has Lomorage set up and an account ready for you, just install the phone app and scan your sign-in code.

faqs.question: Do I have to do something every day?
faqs.answer: Enable automatic backup and choose Wi-Fi-only, charging-only or nighttime backups, plus the folders to include. Your computer or NAS must be on and reachable. Phone systems limit background activity, so keep the app open for a first or large backup and check completion.

faqs.question: Can I delete photos from my phone afterward?
faqs.answer: Free Up Space can remove large local files that have already been backed up. Confirm backup is complete and the originals open correctly before clearing space. Keep another independent copy of irreplaceable photos.

faqs.question: What if my computer breaks?
faqs.answer: Local storage is not a guarantee against loss. Drives can fail and files can be accidentally deleted. Regularly copy important photos to a separate drive and check that those files open correctly.

faqs.question: Does my computer need to be on to view photos?
faqs.answer: To access originals stored on your computer, it must be on and reachable. Offline browsing on your phone depends on what the app has cached; do not assume every original is available offline.

zh.faqTitle: 开始之前，聊清楚几件事。

faqs.question: 是装在手机上，还是电脑上？
faqs.answer: 第一次使用，需要在电脑或 NAS 上准备照片存储，再安装手机应用。家里已经装好，并为你创建了账号？只需安装手机应用，扫描登录码即可。

faqs.question: 需要我每天手动操作吗？
faqs.answer: 可以开启自动备份，选择仅 Wi-Fi、仅充电或夜间备份，也能选择要备份的文件夹。电脑或 NAS 需要开机且可连接。手机系统会限制后台运行，首次或大量备份时建议保持应用打开，并查看完成状态。

faqs.question: 备份以后，手机里的照片就能删了吗？
faqs.answer: 应用中的“释放空间”可以清理已备份的大体积本地文件。先确认备份完成、原文件能正常打开，再进行清理；珍贵照片建议另留一份独立副本。

faqs.question: 如果电脑坏了，照片会不会也丢？
faqs.answer: 存在电脑上不等于永远不会丢。硬盘故障或误删除仍可能导致照片丢失。建议定期把重要照片再复制到另一块独立硬盘，并检查这份副本能正常打开。

faqs.question: 以后找照片，需要电脑一直开着吗？
faqs.answer: 读取保存在电脑里的原文件时，电脑需要开机且网络可达。手机能离线查看哪些内容，取决于应用已缓存的内容；不要假设所有原图都可以离线打开。
